prompts.masked:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a transparent RPG Maker MZ OVERWORLD walking sheet for ONE warrior monk. Reference 1 is the approved warrior monk identity/costume and naginata. Reference 2 is the CURRENT Shinsengumi overworld sheet and is ONLY the style, proportions and walking-grid reference. Match its expressive large head, compact stylized adult body about 3.5 heads tall, bold silhouette, restrained pixel clusters and defined fabric shading. Do NOT use the realistic long body proportions of the battle reference. Subject wears ivory/light gray layered wide-sleeved robes, dark inner sleeves/gloves, red-brown lamellar waist/hip panels, wrapped shins, dark straw sandals. Same outfit and face in ALL frames. One carried NAGINATA with a straight dark wooden shaft, single curved steel blade at the TOP and visible butt, relaxed upright carry beside body, both hands correctly positioned as needed. Preserve the weapon on its anatomical side when turning; one polearm per figure. Full weapon must fit, never crop blade or butt. Extra blank space above head is allowed for weapon; do not shrink body just to fit it.
Layout exactly THREE columns and FOUR rows, TWELVE complete separate figures. Rows strictly: down/front, left-facing profile, right-facing profile, up/back. Columns strictly walk A, feet-together neutral STAND, walk B. Walk A and B MUST show OPPOSITE forward legs and opposite arm swing rather than duplicate poses: in profile the leading sandal/leg must swap, and in front/back the visible forward sandal must switch left-to-right. Consistent head size, body height, costume details, tiny restrained bob, clean separate silhouettes, soles same baseline within row. Equal spaced cells, large transparent gaps; no touching or overlap across cells. Same weapon length throughout. Face must face correct direction even with long weapon. Design for native export of body crown-to-sole height67px, 64x112px cells with sole baseline108; extra canvas is only for polearm clearance. Upper-left light, muted cream/charcoal/brown palette, crisp game pixel art. Genuine alpha transparency. No background, floor, ground shadow, checkerboard, grid, letters, numbers, labels, borders, watermark, extra characters or extra frames. Identity: MASKED hooded warrior monk from reference 1, ivory cloth hood covers scalp, matching cloth wrap covers nose/mouth/neck; only eyes and eyebrows exposed. Keep eye slit, hood and scarf readable in tiny map sprite; back is hood cloth, no visible hair. Do not unmask.
